method: Read the final executable bytes, compute SHA-256, and parse the PE headers and base relocation directory

checks.name: PE32 x86 executable selects the Windows GUI subsystem
Single section has 512-byte headers plus 4,420 file-backed bytes
Complete 122-byte relocation directory parses to the exact end of file
All 57 HIGHLOW relocations address file-backed bytes
Timestamp and checksum are normalized to zero

notes: The final release was rebuilt after the window title and registered class name were changed to chess5kb. The prior 4,935-byte prototype received the interaction tests recorded in gui.json. The final release shares its chess core and GUI behavior but is not byte-identical; this report records build sanity checks, not a fresh run of those interaction tests.
